<translate>
'''Namekian Traders''' are the general-goods merchants of the Namekian villages on [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Planet Namek]]. Every one of them also sells the map to the [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Big Gete Star]], the lair of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Metal Cooler Core|Metal Cooler Core]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Trades ==

Namekian Traders do regular trading: for example Raw Frog Legs, Healing Buckets, Namek Blocks, Tier-2 Radar Chips and Netherite Scrap, in exchange for emeralds and materials.
</translate>

<translate>
== Big Gete Star Map ==

Every trader sells a '''Big Gete Star Map''' for '''16 Emeralds''' (4 uses), pointing to the Big Gete Star. Like the other treasure maps, it shows as '''out of stock''' until the Big Gete Star has been placed in the world and can be located; re-open the trade window to check again.
</translate>

{{See also|Capsule Corp Namekian|Namekian Warrior}}
